Changes made
- Added TTL support and testable time in src/lru.ts.
  - Constructor now accepts options { ttl?: number; now?: () => number }.
  - set(key, value, ttlMs?) supports per-entry TTL override; no TTL means the entry never expires.
  - Expired entries are purged and treated as if they never existed for get/has/delete/size/keys.
  - When inserting and at capacity, expired entries are removed before evicting a live entry.
  - Default now is Date.now but can be injected for tests.

All existing tests pass (7 tests). If you want, I can add unit tests covering TTL behavior (expiry, per-entry TTL, now injection, eviction of expired entries before live ones).
